scope.purpose: Spline-ready source briefs for the nine Galactic mission-site seeds plus the complete 32-family base-game planet/region/location-class art matrix.

owns: Aelos, Veyra, and Karak system presentation
Caldris, Orison, and Meridian planetary context

prohibited: copying or tracing any reference mesh, texture, decal, layout, icon, logo, faction mark, unit, building, character, or named prop
shipping extracted, captured, recreated, or derivative game assets
using a reference screenshot as a texture source
claiming any reference title as provenance for MASSFRONT art
referencePolicy.requiredProvenance: Every delivered model, texture, decal, and concept must be original MASSFRONT work with its actual authoring source recorded.

identityPolicy.sharedKitLimit: Shared structural and gameplay-proxy pieces may support a site, but may not replace its dedicated heroes, materials, decals, or skyline.
identityPolicy.broodRule: Brood is a hostile, non-playable, non-humanoid force. Brood growth is dedicated living geometry and material work, never a recolor of a resident-faction building.

authoringScale.runtimeImportIntent: one source meter to one MASSFRONT world unit until a descriptor-driven import probe proves otherwise
authoringScale.origin: site datum at floor height; modular-piece origins on grid-ready floor contact

titanDiagnostic.reason: The 9-17-unit roads called out in the audit cannot prove TITAN clearance. These compact mission sites explicitly admit only the listed P/L/V/M classes; TITAN and unrestricted strategic forces require a separate measured map contract.

navClasses.notes: Personnel flanks may be narrower than vehicle routes but cannot be the only objective path on a combined-arms site.
Includes light mechs and compact support chassis.
Admission is site- and landing-zone-specific, never inferred from mood art.

combinedArmsClearance.requiredRouteRedundancy: Every V/M-admitting site needs two complete legal routes, or one primary route plus a breach route that is open before permanent primary-route loss.
combinedArmsClearance.clearanceEnvelopeRule: Cover, debris, decals, doors, props, effects, damage meshes, and collision proxies may not intrude into a validated class envelope.
combinedArmsClearance.routeProof: Test every admitted class from every compatible landing zone to objective and extraction in every persistent destruction state.

modeling.modularity: Author straight, corner, T, X, end-cap, portal, vertical, damage, and terrain-contact pieces where the site grammar needs them.
modeling.heroRule: Every named objective and skyline landmark is a dedicated hero family; no generic cube, universal seven-mesh kit, or renamed orbital-contact model may stand in.
modeling.transformRule: Apply transforms before export. Keep reusable pivots at floor contact and rotating or opening pivots on the actual hinge/axis.

requirements: Keep source maps and runtime derivatives separate.
Author seam and channel-alignment proofs before runtime promotion.
Pack decals by site/system ownership; do not bake every marking into every floor tile.
Unique material response, wear, contamination, and signage are mandatory; hue shifts of a shared texture do not satisfy a preset.

rules: Use named deterministic state meshes, not randomized physics piles, for route-affecting destruction.
Every state declares collision, nav, cover, LOS, shot, blast, hazard, and extraction effects.
Objective death or extraction may not strand the player before mission state advances.
Rubble is class-aware: personnel-passable and vehicle-blocking are distinct authored outcomes.
Author each LOD deliberately; blind decimation of thin rails, portals, route silhouettes, or objective landmarks is rejected.
Preserve silhouette, openings, hazard boundaries, emissive landmarks, and damage-state readability at every LOD.
Collision and nav proxies never switch with visual LOD.
Final whole-site triangle, draw-call, and texture residency budgets remain blocked until measured phone GPU evidence exists.
Never use the render mesh as production collision.
Use simple watertight box, capsule, convex, or low-poly static proxies under COLL_ nodes.
Keep walkable NAV_ surfaces, physical collision, gameplay LOS, and projectile blockers separate.
Do not export hidden duplicate render geometry as collision.
Validate gates, ramps, turning courts, landing zones, cover edges, and destruction swaps at source scale.

export.authoringFormat: Spline scene plus editable source GLB
meshRules: UV0 required for every textured mesh
tangent basis required for normal-mapped meshes
no cameras or lights in runtime candidate unless explicitly whitelisted
no embedded concept images or reference-game imagery
materialRules: no unsupported procedural nodes in the candidate export

requiredEvidence: LOS, projectile, blast, hazard, and destruction-state tests
phone portrait tactical and overview captures
phone landscape, tablet, desktop, and foldable captures

locationPresets.identity: Curved inhabited orbital ward with ocean-blue civic glazing, tram circulation, customs governance, and civilian shelter infrastructure.
Regulated cargo lock, inspection apron, mag-tram interchange, and pressure-safe customs core shaped by Aelos civilian traffic.
Exposed phase-relay outpost built around heliostats, radiation shadows, maintenance spars, and a compact control spine.
Aelos relay-security cordon with a dedicated motor apron, hardened control bunker, sensor pickets, and two breachable approach gates.
Crowded commercial docks, cargo carousel, market galleries, cranes, docking clamps, and covert service access.
Dedicated zero-g fuel and cryogenic processing quay with pressure vessels, valve forests, spill containment, and a service-vehicle loop.
Broken pre-UGA archive/transit megaframe under vacuum and gravitic shear, centered on the Orison memory vault.
Black-hole calibration campus of lens petals, umbra platforms, baffles, coolant trenches, and chronometric instruments.
Ancient subsurface processional vault with autonomous apertures, phase machinery, relief walls, and excavation damage.
Ordinary civic colony grid made tragic by silence, evacuation evidence, spore fog, and a breeder nest overtaking recognizable public spaces.
Civilian greenhouse and clinic biodomes with pressure tunnels, quarantine shutters, intact and ruptured shells, and no reused Aelos dome silhouette.
Late UGA containment cordon layered onto a civilian transit court with decon gantries, burn lanes, deployable hardpoints, and visible failed perimeter states.
Subterranean magrail and service artery whose distinct gestation cluster and feeder root occupy different route layers.
Living non-humanoid Brood megastructure of arteries, membrane gates, neural tissues, thermal vents, and the hive heart.

scope.matrixRule: Every planet receives exactly one lore-specific preset for every location class, with two presets allocated to each of its four regions.

planets.worldIdentity: temperate civic capital with intact working infrastructure
dusk-storm foundry world of pressure cities, armor works, and orbital aprons
glacial machine-vault world of automation, frontline scars, cryogenic industry, and orbital weather

planets.factionLanguage: abandoned civilization under non-playable Brood infestation
planets.worldIdentity: volcanic and overgrown hiveworld where infestation is structure and terrain, not a palette modifier

globalOutdoorCombinedArmsKit.contents: Roads, junctions, bridges, gates, walls, pads, utilities, cover, and damage/rubble with 16-30 m lanes and 42-48 m turning courts.

eightLocationClassKits.contents: Dedicated outpost, city/colony, relic/ruin, spaceport, pressure-dome, military-base, refinery, and derelict-megastructure mechanics.

fourPlanetIdentityKits.contents: Sixteen models, eight PBR families, and 24 decals per planet; identity grammar never migrates wholesale to another planet.

exactTotals.runtimeResidencyRule: Load only the current planet identity kit, current location-class kit, and current preset heroes. Source-quality maps remain non-runtime until compressed derivatives and source-matched captures pass.

safeToShare: Hidden gameplay proxies, global lane dimensions, portal metadata schema, collision naming, generic bolts/cables/pipes, generic emergency fixtures, and portable UGA objective/deployment hardware.
System-level structural grammar within Aelos, Veyra, or Karak.
Planet-level weathering and terrain contact layers across that planet's regions.
Class kits such as gantry mechanics or refinery valve logic when the silhouette/material skin remains world-specific.
mustRemainUnique: Every primary objective hero: caldris_customs_core, heliograph_control_spine, morrow_archive_stack, orison_memory_vault, lensing_calibration_core, ossuary_phase_engine, and the four Brood target families.
Site skyline/plan silhouette, landing-zone geometry, damage route, faction/lore signage, story landmark, and objective-state animation.
Ancient Veyra glyphs/phase materials, Aelos civic identity, Meridian civilian signage, and Karak living hive tissue.
Brood biology cannot become a generic playable-faction building skin. Brood remains non-playable and non-humanoid.
NEXUS-VII interior materials cannot be copied wholesale onto orbital sites, and exterior hull material cannot become a universal interior surface.
